raw_graphql_pull_request.body: ## Motivation - Extend the ModelSlim KV-cache infrastructure introduced by the MLA C8 PR to support GQA MXFP8 KV cache on Ascend A5. This enables Qwen models, including models with head dimension 256, to consume QK_MXFP8_DYNAMIC_V_MXFP8_PER_CHANNEL checkpoints and reduce KV-cache memory usage. - To integrate QFA op with no new bubble between steps, support in-graph metadata prepare. To avoid accuracy risks caused by the scheduler modifying req_pool_indices (and other info) of the current batch before they are read, while preparing the next batch.read-done signal for npu. ## Modification - Add a dedicated ModelSlim MXFP8 scheme with dynamic grouped Q/K quantization, static per-channel V quantization, and TP-aware scale loading and replication. - Q (query) and K (key) use dynamic MXFP8 quantization, with one scale computed for each group of 32 consecutive channels within each token and attention head. - V (value) uses static per-channel quantization, with one checkpoint-provided scale for each KV head and channel, shared across all tokens. - Extend the NPU MHA memory pool with paged MXFP8 K/V storage, scale buffers, quantized cache writes, and memory accounting for scales. - Integrate QFA through sgl_kernel_npu.operators.attention for prefill, prefix/chunked prefill, eager decode, graph decode, and MTP execution. - Since QFA supports device-side metadata preparation, move sequence-length updates, page-table construction, and scheduling-metadata generation into the captured graph through the existing metadata hooks to reduce host dispatch overhead and small ops execution gaps. This requires an in-graph preparation path and bypassing FIA-specific host sequence-length updates during QFA graph replay. To protect information (like req_pool_indices) be modified by scheduler too early, also support read-done signal though aclrtRecordEventWithFlag for NPU. - Wire scheme initialization and FA parameter loading into Qwen3 dense/MoE and Qwen3.5/3.6 models, including Qwen3.5 MTP. +import json
+import os
+import re
+import subprocess
+import tempfile
+import unittest
+from pathlib import Path
+
+from sglang.srt.utils import kill_process_tree
+from sglang.test.ascend.e2e.test_npu_accuracy_utils import assert_metrics
+from sglang.test.test_utils import (
+    CustomTestCase,
+    popen_launch_server,
+    terminate_and_kill_process_tree,
+)
+
+
+@unittest.skipUnless(
+    os.environ.get("QWEN3_6_MODELSLIM_MODEL_PATH"),
+    "Set QWEN3_6_MODELSLIM_MODEL_PATH to a local ModelSlim MXFP8 checkpoint",
+)
+class TestQwen3_6_27BModelSlimMXFP8KVGPQA(CustomTestCase):
+    model = os.environ.get("QWEN3_6_MODELSLIM_MODEL_PATH")
+    accuracy = 0.878
+    datasets = ["gpqa_diamond"]
+    served_model_name = "qwen3.6-27b-modelslim-mxfp8-kv"
+    base_url = "http://127.0.0.1:6677"
+    env = {
+        **os.environ,
+        "HCCL_NPU_SOCKET_PORT_RANGE": "auto",
+        "ASCEND_USE_FIA": "1",
+        "HCCL_SOCKET_IFNAME": "lo",
+        "GLOO_SOCKET_IFNAME": "lo",
+        "PYTORCH_NPU_ALLOC_CONF": "expandable_segments:True",
+        "SGLANG_SET_CPU_AFFINITY": "1",
+        "STREAMS_PER_DEVICE": "32",
+    }
+    other_args = [
+        "--served-model-name",
+        served_model_name,
+        "--device",
+        "npu",
+        "--tp-size",
+        "1",
+        "--attention-backend",
+        "ascend",
+        "--quantization",
+        "modelslim",
+        "--page-size",
+        "512",
+        "--dtype",
+        "bfloat16",
+        "--mamba-ssm-dtype",
+        "bfloat16",
+        "--chunked-prefill-size",
+        "8192",
+        "--max-running-requests",
+        "64",
+        "--mem-fraction-static",
+        "0.85",
+        "--trust-remote-code",
+        "--base-gpu-id",
+        os.environ.get("BASE_GPU_ID", "0"),
+        "--mamba-track-interval",
+        "512",
+        "--reasoning-parser",
+        "qwen3",
+        "--kv-cache-dtype",
+        "fp8_e4m3",
+    ]
+    generation_config = {
+        "temperature": 1.0,
+        "top_p": 0.95,
+        "presence_penalty": 0.0,
+        "max_tokens": 81920,
+        "timeout": 3600,
+        # Forward SGLang sampling extensions through the OpenAI API client.
+        "extra_body": {"top_k": 20, "min_p": 0.0, "repetition_penalty": 1.0},
+    }
+
+    @classmethod
+    def setUpClass(cls):
+        cls.process = popen_launch_server(
+            cls.model,
+            cls.base_url,
+            timeout=3600,
+            other_args=cls.other_args,
+            env=cls.env,
+            device="npu",
+        )
+        cls.addClassCleanup(terminate_and_kill_process_tree, cls.process)
+
+    def test_gpqa(self):
+        output_root = Path(
+            os.environ.get("GPQA_OUTPUT_DIR", "./outputs/gpqa_qwen36_27b_mxfp8_kv")
+        )
+        output_root.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+        # Never reuse answers cached by an earlier evaluation.
+        work_dir = Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix="mxfp8_kv_", dir=output_root))
+        command = [
+            "evalscope",
+            "eval",
+            "--model",
+            self.served_model_name,
+            "--api-url",
+            f"{self.base_url}/v1/chat/completions",
+            "--api-key",
+            "EMPTY",
+            "--eval-type",
+            "openai_api",
+            "--datasets",
+            "gpqa_diamond",
+            "--dataset-args",
+            json.dumps(
+                {
+                    "gpqa_diamond": {
+                        "local_path": os.environ.get(
+                            "GPQA_DATASET_PATH", "./gpqa_diamond"
+                        )
+                    }
+                }
+            ),
+            "--eval-batch-size",
+            "64",
+            "--generation-config",
+            json.dumps(self.generation_config),
+            "--work-dir",
+            str(work_dir),
+        ]
+        report_path = None
+        with (
+            (work_dir / "evalscope.log").open("w", encoding="utf-8") as log,
+            subprocess.Popen(
+                command,
+                stdout=subprocess.PIPE,
+                stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,
+                text=True,
+                start_new_session=True,
+            ) as process,
+        ):
+            try:
+                for line in process.stdout:
+                    print(line, end="", flush=True)
+                    log.write(line)
+                    match = re.search(r"Dump report to:\s*(\S+)", line)
+                    if match:
+                        report_path = Path(match.group(1))
+                self.assertEqual(process.wait(), 0, f"See {work_dir}/evalscope.log")
+            finally:
+                if process.poll() is None:
+                    kill_process_tree(process.pid)
+        self.assertIsNotNone(report_path, f"No EvalScope report: {work_dir}")
+        with report_path.open(encoding="utf-8") as report_file:
+            score = float(json.load(report_file)["score"])
+        self.assertTrue(0.0 <= score <= 1.0, f"Invalid GPQA score: {score}")
+        print(f"GPQA Diamond: score={score}, report={report_path}", flush=True)
+        assert_metrics(self, {"accuracy": score})
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    unittest.main()
